rules: Start from pinned GitHub Linguist programming/markup statistics, including its normal generated/vendor/documentation/binary filters.
Remove only listed exact-file exclusions whose SHA-256 and evidence files match the pinned repository commit.
Count the complete bytes of each remaining eligible tracked file, without language weighting or line-based authorship guesses.
Keep maintained mixed-origin files, generators, tests and historical source; duplicated source is not globally deduplicated.
Do not count build outputs, dependency copies, prose or binary archives.
